title: Sunny Deol and Akshaye Khanna star in new courtroom drama 'Ikka', trailer released
summary: The trailer for the upcoming Indian film 'Ikka' has been released, featuring Sunny Deol as a top lawyer and Akshaye Khanna as his difficult client. The movie is directed by Siddharth P. Malhotra and also stars Tillotama Shome and Dia Mirza in key roles. The film's release date has not been announced yet.
summary_points: The trailer for 'Ikka' has been released, showcasing the lead actors
Sunny Deol plays a top lawyer in the movie
Akshaye Khanna stars as his difficult client
The film is directed by Siddharth P. Malhotra
Tillotama Shome and Dia Mirza also have pivotal roles
title_hi: सunny देओल और अक्षय खन्ना ने नए अदालती ड्रामा 'इक्का' की ट्रेलर रिलीज़ की
